background: Bank of China (UK) Limited is the UK-incorporated subsidiary of Bank of China, one of China's four large state-owned commercial banks, serving Chinese corporates, trade finance and the Chinese community in Britain.
synthesis: None of the three main agencies rates the bank, so the assessment rests on its filings and on its parent. Capital is very strong for a UK small bank, with CET1 of 27.2% above the peer median and leverage of 24.4% in the top quarter. Liquidity is ample, LCR of 324% just below the median and NSFR of 194% in the top quarter. Since 31 Dec 2020 every ratio has risen, leverage by 10.1 points and LCR by 81 points, with figures only to 31 Dec 2025.
